skill.name: content-quality-auditor
skill.description: Audits draft or published content against the 80-item CORE-EEAT benchmark, checks publish blockers, and creates a prioritized improvement plan.
skill.summary: Scores content quality, E-E-A-T, and publish readiness with CORE-EEAT.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown fences, inline code formatting, and fixed relative documentation links. Confirmed risks are the local scraper command, intentional URL fetching, and mutable remote runbook fallback. No prompt injection evidence was found in SKILL.md or the two reference files.

remediation.suggestion: Bundle required references with the skill, or pin remote fallback URLs to immutable commits with checksums.

remediation.issue: Local scraper command for URL audits
remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation before scraper execution, validate URL schemes, block private ranges, cap response size, and avoid shell interpolation.
Ask before saving, sanitize the topic filename, store only concise findings, and strip untrusted page text from memory.

remediation.issue: Relative references outside the skill folder
remediation.suggestion: Move required references into the skill package or make missing references a clear setup error.

content.value_statement: Weak content can publish with trust gaps, thin evidence, or unclear search intent. This skill scores content with CORE-EEAT and produces prioritized fixes.
actual_capabilities: Runs the 80-item CORE-EEAT checklist across eight content quality dimensions.
Detects publish blockers for disclosure, intent mismatch, and inconsistent page data.
Calculates dimension scores, GEO score, SEO score, and weighted overall score.
Handles unavailable site-level evidence with N/A scoring rules.
Ranks the top five improvements by weighted score impact.
Creates a publish verdict and a concrete action plan.
limitations: Site-level authority items need extra data, such as backlinks, awards, or media mentions.
It does not replace a legal, medical, or compliance review.
Web audits require user-provided or authorized URLs.
Scores depend on the quality of supplied evidence and content context.

use_cases.title: Pre-Publication Review
use_cases.description: Check a draft before publishing and find trust issues, score gaps, and priority fixes.

use_cases.title: Content Refresh Planning
use_cases.description: Audit an existing page and identify the edits most likely to improve content quality.

use_cases.title: Competitive Content Benchmarking
use_cases.description: Compare your content with a competitor and see which quality dimensions need work.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Publish Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this content for publish readiness: [paste content or URL]. Use the most likely content type.

prompt_templates.title: Content Type Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a CORE-EEAT audit for this [content type]: [content or URL]. Include veto checks and top fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Refresh Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this existing page: [URL]. Focus on weak dimensions, N/A items, and the top five improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Competitive Benchmark
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my page [URL or text] with competitor [URL or text]. Score both and explain the highest-impact gaps.

output_examples.input: A draft buying guide with affiliate links and product claims.
output_examples.output: FIX verdict with missing disclosure, weak first-hand experience, score summary, and priority fixes.

output_examples.input: A how-to article with clear steps but limited sources.
output_examples.output: Good structure score, weak referenceability score, source recommendations, and re-audit steps.

output_examples.input: Two competitor comparison pages for the same keyword.
output_examples.output: Side-by-side quality gaps, higher-weight dimension wins, and a prioritized refresh plan.

best_practices: Provide the full draft, target keyword, and content type when available.
Share site-level evidence if you want Authority and Trust items scored.
Re-run the audit after major edits to verify score movement.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to score content from unauthorized or private URLs.
Do not treat the score as a substitute for expert compliance review.
Do not ignore veto findings because the overall score looks strong.

faq.question: What does this skill audit?
faq.answer: It audits content quality, E-E-A-T signals, publish readiness, and improvement priorities using CORE-EEAT.

faq.question: Can it audit a URL?
faq.answer: Yes, when the URL is user-provided or authorized and accessible to the host tool.

faq.question: Does it need the content type?
faq.answer: It can auto-detect, but specifying content type improves weight selection.

faq.question: How are blocked pages handled?
faq.answer: Critical trust failures are shown first, with immediate fixes recommended before publishing.

faq.question: Can it compare competitors?
faq.answer: Yes, it can compare supplied competitor content and highlight quality gaps.

faq.question: Does it guarantee ranking improvements?
faq.answer: No. It improves content quality signals, but ranking depends on many external factors.
